==Purpose of template==

Format a given date according to user preferences.

==How to use==

<pre>{{Date}}
{{Date|date}}</pre>

==Examples==

===Current date===
<pre>{{Date}}</pre>
{{Date}}

===YYYY-M-D===
<pre>{{Date|1990-1-15}}</pre>
{{Date|1990-1-15}}

===D Mon, YYYY===
<pre>{{Date|15 Jan 1990}}</pre>
{{Date|15 Jan 1990}}

===Month D, YYYY===
<pre>{{Date|January 15 1990}}</pre>
{{Date|January 15 1990}}
